description: Web-side parity: add WebLicenseScreen and WebDocumentSettingsScreen following the web screen convention (WebColors + design-system tokens, web-only, window.alert/confirm, local StyleSheet), and wire them + WebBranchManageScreen into WebNavigator (switch cases, PAGE_NAMES, access control under 'settings'). Runs AFTER FEAT-002 because WebLicenseScreen reads the licenseKey/licenseActivated fields added to storeConfigStore in FEAT-002. Do NOT add visible sidebar menu items (behavior-preserving). Thai UI; loading/empty/error states.
steps: Create src/screens/web/WebLicenseScreen.tsx: `export const WebLicenseScreen: React.FC` (props {}). Web layout like WebSimpleScreens (import WebColors from '../../constants/webColors'; optionally Colors/Space/Radius/Shadow/Font from '../../design-system/tokens'; ScrollView/View/Text/TouchableOpacity; local StyleSheet). Read license state via useStoreConfigStore (licenseKey, licenseActivated) added in FEAT-002. Page title 'ใบอนุญาต / แพ็กเกจการใช้งาน'. Show: license status badge (เปิดใช้งานแล้ว / ยังไม่เปิดใช้งาน), masked license key, a MOCK current plan tier (e.g. const PLAN = {tier:'PROFESSIONAL', label:'แพ็กเกจมืออาชีพ', expiry:'31/12/2568', features:[...Thai feature list...]}) — add a code comment that getPlanTier/getFeaturesByPlan do NOT exist in source so this is mock data. Render features list and expiry. Include loading (brief) + empty state (Thai 'ยังไม่มีข้อมูลใบอนุญาต') + an error guard. Use WebColors only, no hardcoded hex where a token exists.

Create src/screens/web/WebDocumentSettingsScreen.tsx: `export const WebDocumentSettingsScreen: React.FC` (props {}). Web layout convention. Page title 'ตั้งค่าเอกสาร'. Bind a form to useReceiptStore().config + setConfig: fields หัวใบเสร็จ (headerText), เลขที่เอกสาร (posRegNo), ที่อยู่ร้าน (shopAddr), เลขประจำตัวผู้เสียภาษี (shopTaxId), footer ใบเสร็จ (footerText), and a เปิด/ปิดใบกำกับภาษี toggle using RN Switch. For the toggle add an optional `taxInvoiceEnabled?: boolean` field to ReceiptConfig in src/store/receiptStore.ts (default true) and persist via setConfig; if you prefer not to touch the store, keep it local useState and add a code comment. บันทึก button calls setConfig(...) and shows success feedback (window.alert or an inline 'บันทึกแล้ว' banner). Loading + error states. Use WebColors tokens.

Wire src/navigation/WebNavigator.tsx (W3): import WebLicenseScreen, WebDocumentSettingsScreen, and WebBranchManageScreen (from '../screens/web/...'). Add to PAGE_NAMES: licenses:'ใบอนุญาต', documents:'ตั้งค่า › เอกสาร', branches:'สาขา'. In renderContent() switch add: case 'licenses': return <WebLicenseScreen/>; case 'documents': return <WebDocumentSettingsScreen/>; case 'branches': return <WebBranchManageScreen/>;. Access control in navigate(): since rolePermissions has no 'licenses'/'documents'/'branches' keys, compute accessKey so that these three map to 'settings' (e.g. const accessKey = r.startsWith('report_') ? 'reports' : (['documents','licenses','branches'].includes(r) ? 'settings' : r);). Keep the existing non-report canAccess guard working for these routes (treat them as settings). Do NOT modify WebSidebar.tsx / NAV_ITEMS (no new visible menu entries).
acceptance_criteria: src/screens/web/WebLicenseScreen.tsx and src/screens/web/WebDocumentSettingsScreen.tsx exist and export the named React.FC components with no props.
WebLicenseScreen reads licenseActivated/licenseKey from storeConfigStore and renders mock plan tier + features; a comment documents the mock.
WebDocumentSettingsScreen binds to useReceiptStore config/setConfig for the six document settings + a tax-invoice toggle, with a working บันทึก action.
WebNavigator registers cases 'licenses','documents','branches' with matching PAGE_NAMES and gates all three under 'settings' access; WebSidebar is unchanged.
npx tsc --noEmit total error count stays <= 13 and no error references any file created/edited in this feature.
verification: npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | Select-String "error TS" | Measure-Object  (expect Count <= 13; inspect that none of the lines reference WebLicenseScreen, WebDocumentSettingsScreen, WebNavigator, receiptStore)
npm run test   (expect no new failures vs baseline)
findings: DONE. Created src/screens/web/WebLicenseScreen.tsx (React.FC, no props): reads licenseKey/licenseActivated from useStoreConfigStore (FEAT-002 fields); page title 'ใบอนุญาต / แพ็กเกจการใช้งาน'; status badge เปิดใช้งานแล้ว/ยังไม่เปิดใช้งาน; masked license key (last 4 visible); MOCK plan tier const PLAN {tier:'PROFESSIONAL', label:'แพ็กเกจมืออาชีพ', expiry:'31/12/2568', features:[6 Thai items]} with an explicit comment that getPlanTier/getFeaturesByPlan do NOT exist in source so data is mock; loading (200ms), error guard, and empty state ('ยังไม่มีข้อมูลใบอนุญาต' when !activated && !key). Uses WebColors + design-system tokens (Space/Radius/Font), local StyleSheet, web-only. Created src/screens/web/WebDocumentSettingsScreen.tsx (React.FC, no props): binds to useReceiptStore().config + setConfig; page title 'ตั้งค่าเอกสาร'; six-ish fields headerText(หัวใบเสร็จ), posRegNo(เลขที่เอกสาร), shopAddr(ที่อยู่ร้าน, multiline), shopTaxId(เลขประจำตัวผู้เสียภาษี), footerText(footer ใบเสร็จ, multiline), plus a RN Switch toggle เปิด/ปิดใบกำกับภาษี; บันทึก button calls setConfig(...) and shows inline 'บันทึกแล้ว' banner; loading + error states. ReceiptConfig in src/store/receiptStore.ts gained optional `taxInvoiceEnabled?: boolean` (default true in DEFAULT), persisted via setConfig. WebNavigator.tsx (src/navigation): imported WebLicenseScreen, WebDocumentSettingsScreen, WebBranchManageScreen; added PAGE_NAMES licenses:'ใบอนุญาต', documents:'ตั้งค่า › เอกสาร', branches:'สาขา'; switch cases 'licenses'/'documents'/'branches'; access control in navigate() and the render guard map these three to 'settings' (accessKey = startsWith report_ ? reports : (['documents','licenses','branches'].includes(r) ? 'settings' : r)). WebSidebar.tsx / NAV_ITEMS NOT modified (no visible menu entries). Verification: `npx tsc --noEmit` = 13 error TS lines (== baseline), all in pre-existing files (BranchSelector, DatePicker, PermissionMatrixScreen, RoleManageScreen, WebUserStaffScreen 'Platform', errorTracking), none referencing WebLicenseScreen/WebDocumentSettingsScreen/WebNavigator/receiptStore. `npm run test` = 39 passed, 0 failed, same 3 pre-existing suite-load failures (engine.test.ts, SyncService.test.ts, branchPermissionStore.test.ts — react-native/index.js vite import-analysis error, unrelated).
